title: Berlin Brothersvalley football hopes to take next step in D5-2A - NewsBreak
text:
By Adam Ripple ,
1 days ago Dante Paul took over as head coach for his father, Doug, who stepped down the season prior, and guided Berlin Brothersvalley to a 7-win campaign and a District 5-2A title berth in 2025.
The Mountaineers have a crop of talent back, ready to take another stride forward in Coach Paul's second season at the helm.
"These guys understand my expectations and what we are all about," said Paul. "Our scheme is a little bit better this year. In camp, we've picked up on a lot of stuff in a more rapid pace, just because we have that experience. We hope that experience carries over into Friday nights."
Berlin Brothersvalley rushed for 1,826 yards and 15 touchdowns last season, much in part to junior running back Carter Durst, who notched 868 yards and nine scores as well as 536 yards and four scores from Seth Kimmel, who graduated. While the ground game was good, the Mountaineers struggled moving the ball through the air, accounting for just 595 yards and 12 touchdowns.

Second-year senior quarterback Brady Janidlo has weapons in Carson Janidlo, who led the team with six touchdown catches, Ryan Janidlo and Dawson Shaffer to go along with Durst's running abilities. It's simply a matter of execution this season.
"Two of the biggest things that hurt us last year was playing behind the sticks, whether it was dropped snaps or penalties, and the other thing was that we got outplayed physically," Paul said. "We want to be more physical, execute our blocks and communicate up front. If we can do that, we will be more successful on offense."
Senior 2-year starter Jake Philip anchors a Berlin Brothersvalley defense that allowed an average of just 13.5 points per game last season. Paul, who previously served as the defensive coordinator, takes great pride in that unit.
"We have a veteran group on defense that is going to bring the younger guys along as well," Paul said. "We don't always have the biggest guys on the field. However, if I can get 11 guys to play fast and with a lot of heart, we are going to find ourselves in a lot of football games. A lot of times, that makes the difference."
Coach: Dante Paul – second season, 7-5 career record
2025 record: 6-3 in Inter-County Conference, 7-5 overall
Top players lost: Seth Kimmel (LB/RB), Levi Leonard (OL/DL), Carter Twombly (DL).
Top returning players: Carter Durst (RB/DE), Jake Philip (LB/OL), Corbin Kordell (ATH/DB), Ryan Janidlo (DE/TE), Brady Janidlo (QB/FS), Carson Janidlo (WR), Mason Hoyman (ATH/SS), Alex Clutts (OL).
Assistant coaches: Bob Bowers, Isaiah Paul, Brentson Harding, Tom Dorcon, Sam Dively, Tanner Coughenour, Alex Charlton, Scott Ressler, Colin Stoltzfus, Nick Crites, Brody Moore.
District/classification: 5-2A
Last district playoff appearance: 2025
Last district playoff win: 2025
District titles in program history: Seven
